nodes.title: Next.js feedback bot
nodes.summary: Implements a feedback interface using LangGraph state machine to drive conversation.

nodes.title: Duplicate frontend pages
nodes.summary: Main and widget pages contain nearly identical flow logic, causing redundancy.

nodes.title: Missing shared hook
nodes.summary: No common hook abstracts duplicated flow, leading to repeated code.

nodes.title: Dual state stores
nodes.summary: graph.ts maintains both an in-memory Map and a MemorySaver checkpointer, creating inconsistent state sources.

nodes.title: Rating persistence mismatch
nodes.summary: In-memory store keeps rating across calls while checkpointer never aggregates full state, causing data loss.

nodes.title: Graph-executor mismatch
nodes.summary: Defined graph ends at END but executor manually re-invokes graph, contradicting intended flow.

nodes.title: Unused Prisma DB layer
nodes.summary: db.ts and Prisma are present but never accessed, adding dead code.

nodes.title: Global Toaster import
nodes.summary: layout.tsx loads toast components globally though no page uses them, inflating bundle size.

nodes.title: Unused sidebar UI imports
nodes.summary: sidebar.tsx imports many UI components that feedback pages never use, creating unnecessary dependencies.

nodes.title: Mutable SMTP transporter
nodes.summary: smtp.ts creates transporter as mutable module variable and reads env vars at call time, risking inconsistent configuration.

nodes.title: Widget global mutable state
nodes.summary: widget.js relies on shared mutable variables without encapsulation, leading to coupling and side effects.

nodes.title: Feedback flow steps
nodes.summary: Defined sequence INIT-askRating-validateRating-askFeedback-captureAndSend-thankYou governs user interaction.

nodes.title: Invalid input loop
nodes.summary: Validation failures or email errors cause the flow to loop back, potentially trapping users.

nodes.title: Frontend feedback API
nodes.summary: Client POSTs sessionId, userInput, and currentStep to /api/feedback, expecting a structured response.

nodes.title: Backend response payload
nodes.summary: Returns botMessage, nextStep, rating, and emailSent status to guide next client action.

nodes.title: Single source of truth
nodes.summary: Consolidating state into one store eliminates inconsistencies and simplifies reasoning.

nodes.title: Extract shared hook
nodes.summary: Refactor duplicated logic into a reusable hook to reduce code duplication.

nodes.title: Align executor with graph
nodes.summary: Remove manual re-invocation and let the graph handle step progression naturally.

nodes.title: Remove dead DB code
nodes.summary: Delete db.ts and Prisma imports to clean codebase and reduce bundle size.

nodes.title: Eliminate unnecessary toasts
nodes.summary: Delete global toast imports and usage where not needed.

nodes.title: Prune unused UI imports
nodes.summary: Strip sidebar's unused component imports to streamline dependencies.

nodes.title: Initialize SMTP once
nodes.summary: Create transporter at module load with env vars, avoiding mutable reinitialization.

nodes.title: Encapsulate widget state
nodes.summary: Wrap widget variables in a closure or component state to prevent global side effects.

nodes.title: Robust email error handling
nodes.summary: Implement explicit handling for email failures to avoid silent loops.

nodes.title: Terminate feedback loop
nodes.summary: Ensure flow reaches thankYou and stops, preventing infinite repetitions.

nodes.title: SessionId based tracking
nodes.summary: Use sessionId to correlate user steps across requests, enabling stateless server design.
